description: Use this when a signed-in user wants their logo animated: a website hero animation (interactive loop the user places on their site) or an app launch animation (plays once, ends on the logo). Pass exactly one of design_id (one of their ready AI logo designs, from design_logo, get_design or list_designs) or logo (an image they shared). Ask the same questions as the app: hero or launch, where it will be used (and the web stack for web), the background colour it sits on, and how it should feel. Charmotion's creative director proposes 3 concepts (takes up to a minute). Concepts are free and use nothing from the plan. Show the concepts and let the user pick one, then call build_motion. Nothing is built yet. Requires a linked Charmotion account.

background.description: Optional: the page background (hero) or launch screen colour it sits on, as #rrggbb.

brand_name.description: Optional brand name (a logo design's brand is used when left out).

brief.description: Optional: anything else about the feel or the motion, in the user's words.

design_id.description: A ready AI logo design of this account, instead of a logo image. Its flat background is removed and its brand name is used.

feel.description: Optional: how it should feel. A logo design's feel is used when left out.

goal.description: hero = website hero animation (interactive loop); launch = app launch / splash animation that plays once.

logo.description: The logo (SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB). Outside ChatGPT, set download_url to a public https link to the image and file_id to its file name. Leave out when using design_id.

web_stack.description: Optional, for platform web: the site's stack.

name: start_motion

ai_readme.description: AI_README.md for a ready logo animation (get_motion only): the files, which code to use per platform, how to install and paste it, how the animation behaves (pointer reactions for a hero, play once for a launch), reduced motion and checks. Give it to the coding assistant that adds the animation to the user's app or site.

result.description: When ready: live preview link, code per platform, requirements, quality check and 10-minute download links.

title: Start a logo animation
